For the MT-TP7 industrial PoE range (TP7308POE, TP7-16GT240BT), we can be a second ODM source on a Marvell platform (DIN-rail 8-PoE + 2 SFP managed, 90 W PoE++ option, 16-PoE + 2×10G) from small lots in your housing, CE/RoHS — which model would you dual-source first?
